_comment: Speech-only PCM MD5 hashes of known degraded/quota-limit Homeway responses. Confirmed entries were captured directly from HA's own config/tts cache (pre-chime, exactly what the runtime check hashes) - no trimming/derivation needed for these. Add more the same way: pull the raw file straight from config/tts right after reproducing a limit-hit, before it gets cleared.

5d24f381d523c595652a493a365c66a8: Homeway limit/quota response, variant B - 8.22s, distinct from variant A (different duration/hash, not just another locale-tag rotation), captured es-ar tagged
